name: triceps-dip-bench
title: Triceps Dip (Bench)
primer: This exercise is one of the most basic and still one of the best for building the triceps.
steps: Place two benches parallel to each other 3-4 feet apart.
Sit on one bench and place your feet on the edge of the other bench so that your legs are suspended between the 2 benches.
Hold onto the bench with your hands for support and slowly lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause and then return to the starting position.
tips: Do not go below a 90 degree angle as this can cause strain on your shoulders.
